pv.description: Any one of CPU, MEM, Disk, FD, Process of the host is in alarm state

guidance.title: System is an abnormal state
guidance.details: Check the mentioned alarm load and identify the cause

display.title: System Health Alarm OPI
display.details: /opt/codac/opi/boy/resources/alarmpages/healthMonitoring/ITER-SYSM-SHLT_Alarm.opi "CBS=TEST-TEST-SYSM, PPPP=55TE, PP=ST, TTT=PSH, NNNN=000, ALARM_PV=TEST-TEST-SYSM-55TE-ST:PSH000-SHLT, ALARM_PATH=/CODAC_AlarmHandler/TEST/TEST-TEST/TEST-TEST-SYSM, LEVEL=ITER-TEST-TEST-SYSM, ALARM_GUIDANCE1_TITLE=System resource utilization is high, ALARM_GUIDANCE1_DETAILS=Any one of CPU / MEM / Disk / FD / Process of the host is in alarm state. Check the mentioned alarm load and identify the cause. If any load remains high continuously contact maintenance service."

guidance.title: System resources related to the alarm
guidance.details: 1 - one of CPU, Disk, Memory, FD load is high or necessary process has been stopped 2 - two of CPU, Disk, Memory, FD load are high and/or necessary process has been stopped 3 - three of CPU, Disk, Memory, FD load are high and/or necessary process has been stopped

guidance.title: Corrective action
guidance.details: If any load remains high continuously, contact maintenance service. In addition, check if the necessary processes are running

guidance.title: Temporary actions to suppress
guidance.details:
Change the alarm limits or severity for each load in alarm state.
Ex1) alarm limits % caput TEST-TEST-SYSM-55TE-ST:PSH000-CPUUTL.HIGH 90 % caput TEST-TEST-SYSM-55TE-ST:PSH000-CPUUTL.HIHI 100
Ex2) alarm severity % caput TEST-TEST-SYSM-55TE-ST:PSH000-MEMUTL.HSV NO_ALARM % caput TEST-TEST-SYSM-55TE-ST:PSH000-MEMUTL.HHSV NO_ALARM
